correctness.rationale: Legendre yields exactly 2s_2(n)-s_2(3n). The carry state c=0,1,2 with terminal digit correction gives the exact Laurent transfer identity. Symbolic inversion yields the claimed rational GF; derivatives give exact moments, independently checked at 16 depths; M(1) primitive with eigenvalues 2,1,-1, and lambda'(1)=1 and lambda''(1)=4/3 yield asymptotic variance 11/12>0 and Gaussian limit. Boundaries L=0,1 included. Finite tests support but do not establish all-L proof.

value.rationale: The binomial family occurs in early digit-valuation sequence problems and is a natural Kummer carry process. The exact rational block enumerator determines every valuation frequency simultaneously and, unusually, yields finite-depth mean/variance with parity-dependent boundary corrections plus an evaluated variance slope. This is a complete arithmetic distribution and not a mere parity or zero-class deduction. Subsequent work can use exact dyadic thresholds and error moments.
